output.reason: [ev-7f40c22f3620] describes an opt-in addition: the Kyverno CLI "now allows" global context entries to be injected through a Values file for policy testing, "without modifying GlobalContextEntry resources in your cluster". Nothing in it says that any existing resource, setting, workload or upgrade step fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or needs migration. So an operator who does nothing is not affected, and the consequence kind "none" (informational) is correct.
